gold_access: protocol assertion and post-generation scoring only; never prompt-visible
runtime_resource_policy: Outcome-free task resources are identical across context arms. Shopping receives the post-intervention availability snapshot and only catalog entities present in the runtime state; simulator tool-query outcomes are not disclosed.

decoder_gate.rule: both arms must meet both thresholds on every task before test API work

invalid_response_policy: Transport failures and incomplete (length/empty) completions are retried. Unresolved API/schema failures make the block incomplete and are excluded from semantic accuracy. The gate requires complete semantic coverage; only valid JSON state values can be semantic failures.
